name: Vellum
tagline: Vellum is a platform for building, testing, and deploying LLM-powered applications with tools for prompt engineering, evaluation, and workflow orchestration. It provides a visual editor for chaining LLM calls, version-controlled prompt templates, and a test suite for validating AI outputs.
